(2) A young girl in a floral sleeveless outfit runs through a brightly lit hallway towards the camera, holding a blue Doraemon-themed spherical container. Her face shows excitement with an open-mouthed smile as she sprints. (3) The girl reaches the boy near the entrance and hugs his legs tightly. The boy is removing his shoes by a dark wooden door decorated with a red lunar new year banner. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video captures a heartwarming domestic moment where a young girl excitedly welcomes her older brother home after a three-day school trip. It uses a POV filming style to immerse the viewer in the family's joy and sibling bond.
